Lords of the Barren Rim}} }} The '''''Munificent''-class star frigate''', also known as the '''''Munificent''-class star Banking Clan frigate''', '''''Munificent''-class heavy frigate''', '''Separatist frigate''' or '''Banking Clan frigate''', was a [[warship]] designed by [[Hoersch-Kessel Drive, Inc.|Hoersch-Kessel Drive Inc.]] and [[Gwori Revolutionary Industries]] for use by the [[InterGalactic Banking Clan]], the [[Trade Federation]], and later the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems]] during the [[Clone Wars]]. ==Characteristics== ===Dimensions=== [[File:Munificient_frigate_Cross-section.png|thumb|left|270px|A cross-section of a ''Munificent'' star frigate]] Designed by the [[starship]] manufacturing company [[Hoersch-Kessel Drive, Inc.|Hoersch-Kessel Drive Inc.]] and [[Gwori Revolutionary Industries]], the ''Munificent''-class star frigates were powerful, multi-role starships that served within the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems Navy|naval forces]] of the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems]]. Often referred to as "[[pocket cruiser]]s," the [[frigate]] measured to 825 [[meter]]s in length, 426 meters in width, and 243 meters in height, and were fast, lightly [[armor]]ed [[warship]]s that were designed to operate in [[squadron]]s supported by smaller craft to take down larger [[capital ship]]s. They were powered by twin [[reactor]]s. ===Defenses=== Among the most feared warships in the Separatist [[fleet]], the ''Munificent''-class was equipped with a large array of weapons that made the vessel more than a match for anything the [[Galactic Republic]] [[Republic Navy|Navy]] possessed in similar size and firepower, armed with two forward-mounted heavy [[turbolaser]] [[cannon]]s, capable of blast-melting an ice moon 1,000 kilometers in diameter or piercing the shields of a 10 kilometer wide Grade III battle station, two forward-mounted heavy [[ion cannon]]s, thirteen port and thirteen starboard twin light turbolaser cannons, ten port and ten starboard [[turret]]-mounted light turbolasers, six port and six starboard medium [[flak gun]]s, and ten dorsal, ten ventral, ten port, and ten starboard turret-mounted retractable twin light laser cannons, as well as several ordnance launchers and a [[hyperwave]] [[jammer]]. The frigates were also equipped with a [[deflector shield generator]]. ===Complement and crew===
[[File:Munificentbridge.png|thumb|left|270px|[[B1-series battle droid]] aboard the [[Bridge (starship)|bridge]] of a ''Munificent'']]
''Munificent''-class frigates were almost entirely automated, with a nominal crew of around 200, who saw to the vessel's maintenance and daily operations. And the ships' remaining interior space was used for machinery, redundant systems, [[hangar]] facilities that could hold up to four squadrons of [[Vulture-class starfighter|vulture droids]]. They were also used to ferry a passenger capacity of 150,000 [[battle droid]]s of various types that were kept in stasis, and could hold up to two [[Standard year|years]] worth of consumables and a cargo capacity of 10,000 [[metric ton]]s for encumbrance. ===Propulsion, communications, and navigation systems=== [[File:MunificentAft-USWNE.png|thumb|270px|left|Aft view of a ''Munificent''-class frigate]] Boasting a maximum atmospheric speed of 950 [[Kilometer per hour|kilometers per hour]] from seven [[Ion engine|ion drive]] [[Engine|thrusters]], the ''Munificent''-class was equipped with a Class 1 [[hyperdrive]] generator and a Class 10 generator as a backup. The frigate was also equipped with two long-range hyperwave transceiver masts for communications, a long-range [[sensor]] tower, high performance sensors with a range of several light-days and a [[navigation computer]]. ==History== ===Clone Wars=== ====Battle of Christophsis==== Several months after the [[First Battle of Geonosis]] in [[22 BBY]],''[[Star Wars: Timelines]]'' which marked the beginning of the [[Clone Wars]] between the Galactic Republic and the Confederacy of Independent Systems, the Confederacy sent their [[Separatist Droid Army|Droid Army]] under the command of [[General]] [[Whorm Loathsom]] and the [[Sith assassin]] [[Asajj Ventress]] to capture the planet [[Christophsis]],{{TCW|The Hidden Enemy}} due to its resources and position along the [[Corellian Run]] [[hyperspace route]],''[[Star Wars: On the Front Lines]]'' while the planet was placed under a [[Christophsis blockade|blockade]] with a fleet of at 30 warships commanded by the [[Harch]] [[Admiral]] [[Trench]], to prevent the Republic from intervening. It was flagged by the [[Providence-class Dreadnought|''Providence''-class Dreadnought]], ''[[Invincible]]'', and also included of at least twenty-three ''Munificent''-class star frigates,[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars (film)|''Star Wars: The Clone Wars'' film]] six [[Lucrehulk-class battleship|''Lucrehulk''-class Battleships]],{{TCW|Cat and Mouse}} and at least one [[Hardcell-class Battle Refit|battle refitted]] [[Hardcell-class interstellar transport|''Hardcell''-class interstellar transport]].{{FFGYouTube|10qOUFfWU4g|GenCon Online 2020: Fantasy Flight Games In-Flight Report}} [[File:Hardcell-Battle-Refit.png|thumb|right|270px|A ''Hardcell''-class Battle Refit and ''Munificent''-class star frigates at Christophsis]] Later, after the Republic arrived to [[Battle of Christophsis|break]] the blockade, Trench managed to quickly overpower the Republic [[Skywalker's fleet|fleet]] of three [[Venator-class Star Destroyer|''Venator''-class Star Destroyers]] and three [[Pelta-class frigate|''Pelta''-class frigates]] led by [[Jedi Knight]] [[Anakin Skywalker]] aboard his Venator, the ''[[Resolute]]'', by destroying one of the frigates, which were to deliver supplies to [[Senator]] [[Bail Prestor Organa|Bail Organa]] on the surface below, and Skywalker was forced to retreat behind the planet's moon of [[Leesis]]. However, Skywalker later returned piloting a prototype [[IPV-2C Stealth Corvette]], and managed to break through the blockade by destroying the ''Invincible'' after a brief showdown with the [[dreadnought]], sending the entire blockade into disarray. After the Republic managed to establish a base on the surface, the blockade continued to fight against the Republic's fleet above commanded by Admiral [[Wullf Yularen]], however, they managed to break through once more with aid from the [[Wurtz's fleet|fleet]] of Admiral [[Wurtz]]. ====Battle of Teth==== [[File:Sky_fight_over_Teth.png|thumb|left|270px|A Venator and Munificent battle at Teth]] Not long after their victory at Christophsis, Skywalker and his [[Padawan]] [[Ahsoka Tano]] traveled to the planet [[Teth]] in [[Wild Space]] in order to rescue the [[Hutt]]let [[Rotta]], the son of [[Jabba Desilijic Tiure]]. After they reached the Huttlet, following a battle with at least two [[battalion]]s worth of battle droids, General [[Obi-Wan Kenobi]], aboard a Venator, arrived in the [[Teth system|system]] with his [[212th Attack Battalion]] and assisted Skywalker's [[Torrent Company]] fighting Separatist reinforcements, while the Venator and a squadron of Republic fighters engaged the Separatist frigate and several Vulture droids. ====Fall of Ryloth==== After the Separatist Droid Army, led by [[Techno Union]] [[Foreman]] [[Wat Tambor]], invaded the planet [[Ryloth]], the Separatist Alliance established a [[Ryloth blockade|blockade]] in the planet's orbit under the command of [[Neimoidian]] [[Captain]] [[Mar Tuuk]]. The blockade, consisting of a single ''Lucrehulk''-class Battleship accompanied by six Munificents, including [[Battlecruiser 17|Battlecruisers 17]] and [[Battlecruiser 19|19]],{{TCW|Innocents of Ryloth}} was able to destroy the Republic [[Dao's fleet|fleet]] of Admiral [[Dao]], which was providing support for Jedi General [[Ima-Gun Di]]'s [[Outer Rim garrison]], all of which had perished while holding off the Separatist forces for the [[Twi'lek Resistance]] led by [[Cham Syndulla]] to escape.{{TCW|Supply Lines}} ====Ambush on Rugosa==== [[File:Munificentsvsrepfrigate.png|thumb|right|270px|Separatist frigates attack Yoda's cruiser]] While on a diplomatic [[Battle of Rugosa|mission]] to the Outer Rim [[moon]] [[Rugosa]] at the request of the [[Toydarian]] [[King]] [[Katuunko]], Jedi [[Grand Master]] [[Yoda]] was ambushed by two Munificents that attempted to kill the Jedi Master in order to prevent him from meeting with Katuunko on the moon's surface. The two frigates forced Yoda's [[Consular-class cruiser (Charger c70 retrofit)|''Consular''-class cruiser]] to retreat from the [[Rugosa system|star system]], but not before launching all of its [[escape pod]]s with Yoda and his clone troopers inside them.{{TCW|Ambush}} ====Battle of the Rishi Moon==== During the [[Defense of Rishi Station|battle]] of the [[Rishi Moon]], the Separatist [[General]] [[Grievous]] commanded a fleet of nine ''Munificent''-class frigates and two ''Lucrehulk''-class Battleships. His forces had infiltrated the [[Rishi Station|outpost]] located on the moon, intending to keep the all-clear signal active in order for him and his fleet to succeed in their planned surprise attack on the cloning planet of [[Kamino]]. However, several clones had survived the initial attack and with the help of [[Clone Commander]] [[Cody]] of the [[212th Attack Battalion]] and [[Clone Captain]] [[Rex]] of the [[501st Legion]], they managed to retake the base and destroy it after Grievous had sent a [[C-9979 landing craft]] with reinforcements onboard, deactivating the all-clear signal and alerting the Republic of Grievous's attack, forcing the general and his fleet to retreat.{{TCW|Rookies (episode)}} ====Battle of Bothawui==== [[File:CIS_fleet.jpg|thumb|left|270px|Separatist frigates during the Battle of Bothawui]] During the [[Battle of Bothawui|Battle of]] [[Bothawui]] in 22 BBY, Grievous commanded a fleet of six ''Munificent''-class star frigates against Skywalker's fleet of three ''Venator''-class Star Destroyers. The Separatist fleet initially gained the upper hand in terms of firepower, managing to destroy one of the Venators, but all six frigates were soon destroyed after being outflanked by several [[All Terrain Tactical Enforcer]]s hiding in the asteroid field, and Grievous proceeded to make his retreat from [[Grievous's frigate|his]] personal frigate. Not long after his defeat at Bothawui, Grievous used two more Munificents to [[Mission to suspected Confederate space|ambush]] Skywalker, who had decided to scout ahead in an outer corridor of space. However, Skywalker was able to escape the [[Kaleesh]] with the help of his Padawan Ahsoka Tano and his Rex, who piloted the [[G9 Rigger-class light freighter|G9 ''Rigger''-class light freighter]] ''[[Twilight]]'' after Skywalker's [[Anakin Skywalker's Delta-7B Aethersprite-class light interceptor|starfighter's]] [[Homing beacon|tracking beacon]] suddenly activated, which had alerted Grievous to his location. ====Skirmish near Vanqor==== The Republic later devised a plan to capture the Separatist [[Head of State|leader]] [[Count]] [[Dooku]] to bring the war to a quicker end. The first phase was for Anakin Skywalker to sneak his way onto a lone ''Munificent''-class star frigate, which was the [[Count Dooku's frigate|personal flagship]] of the Count, without his lightsaber and allow himself to be captured.{{TCW|Dooku Captured}} Obi-Wan Kenobi later arrived on the ship in the [[Vanqor system]] sometime after Skywalker was captured, and freed the captive Jedi, where the two then [[Skirmish at Vanqor|attempted]] to capture Dooku. Skywalker's flagship, the ''[[Resolute]]'', arrived moments later and engaged the frigate, with clone troopers boarding the vessel to aid them. However, Dooku managed to escape the frigate aboard [[Count Dooku's solar sailer|his]] [[Punworcca 116-class interstellar sloop|''Punworcca 116''-class interstellar sloop]], but was subsequently pursued by the Jedi who had commandeered a ''Sheathipede''-class shuttle. ====Battle of Quell==== During the [[Battle of Quell|Battle of]] [[Quell]], the [[T-series military strategic analysis and tactics droid]] [[TF-1726]] used several ''Munificent''-class frigates against Jedi General [[Aayla Secura]] and her [[Aayla Secura's task force|task force]] of three Venators, and commanded the Separatist forces from his [[TF-1726's Munificent-class star frigate|own Munificent]].{{TCW|Jedi Crash}} [[File:Battle_of_Quell.png|thumb|right|270px|B2-RPs are deployed from the Separatist fleet]] As General Skywalker was en route to the [[Quell system]] to aid Secura's forces, two of her Venators had been destroyed, and the [[tactical droid]] deployed several [[B2-RP battle droid|B2-RP super battle droids]] to board Secura's damaged Star Destroyer, intending to speed up its destruction. However, Skywalker, onboard the ''Resolute'', entered the system and deployed several [[Low Altitude Assault Transport/infantry]] [[gunship]]s to board the ship and rescue General Secura. After entering the damaged Venator through a breach in its hull, Skywalker and his forces pushed forward to join Secura and her Clone Commander [[Bly]], and explained that he had a [[Unidentified Consular-class cruiser (Quell)|frigate]] docking in the lower hangar to evacuate the survivors. The Separatist frigates pressed their attack on the Star Destroyer, which subsequently caused an internal explosion as the survivors were evacuating onto the cruiser, and managed to severely injure Skywalker, who used the Force to hold the explosion back. ====Liberation of Ryloth==== [[File:Breaking_Ryloth_blockade.png|thumb|left|270px|The blockade fires on the ''Resolute''{{'s}} ventral side.]] Later, General Skywalker along with his Padawan Ahsoka Tano, were sent with their fleet to break through the blockade so Generals Obi-Wan Kenobi, [[Mace Windu]] and the [[Ryloth invasion fleet|invasion fleet]] could land on the planet's surface. However, after Tano and her fighter squadron broke the line of droid fighters, Captain Tuuk summoned four more frigates—including [[Battlecruiser 17|Battlecruisers 17]] and [[Battlecruiser 19|19]]—along with more fighters. The blockade's fighters began to overwhelm the Republic forces, destroying Tano's squadron one by one, and making suicide runs on the Star Destroyers ''Resolute'', ''[[Redeemer]]'', and ''[[Defender]]''. And when a vulture droid crashed into the ''Resolute''{{'s}} bridge, Skywalker ordered his fleet to retreat, but the ''Redeemer'' and most of Tano's squadron were lost in their first attack. Despite his forces being depleted, Skywalker returned to the blockade in the heavily damaged ''Defender'', and offered to surrender himself and the ship to Tuuk in exchange for delivery of supplies to the [[Twi'lek]]s. Considering his offer, Tuuk was soon informed that Skywalker was the only onboard the Star Destroyer, and despite attempting to destroy the ''Defender'', the vessel crashed into the Lucrehulk. The rest of the blockade then proceeded to open fire on the ''Resolute'', which had [[Marg Sabl|angled]] its hull towards the blockade, but the remaining frigates were subsequently destroyed as Ahsoka led her fighter squadron against them, and allowed the invasion fleet to land as it exited hyperspace. ====Battle on Felucia==== During the [[First Battle of Felucia|battle]] of [[Felucia]], the Confederacy established a [[Felucia blockade|blockade]] of at least four Munificents in the planet's orbit, which had cut off the Republic fleet from their forces on the ground below led by Generals Kenobi and Skywalker. The Republic managed to break through the blockade by destroying one of the frigates, and proceeded to extract the Jedi and their troops from the battle.{{TCW|Holocron Heist}} ====Battle of Devaron==== [[File:Showdown_at_Devaron.png|thumb|right|270px|Frigates at the Battle of Devaron]] During the [[Battle of Devaron|battle of]] the planet [[Devaron]], the [[bounty hunter]] [[Cad Bane]], commanded a fleet of four ''Munificent''-class frigates supplied to him by the Trade Federation to aid him in his mission to retrieve Jedi Master [[Bolla Ropal]], who was out of contact on Devaron at the time. However, after Bane managed to take Master Ropal captive aboard his frigate, Skywalker soon arrived in the system aboard the ''Resolute'' and immediately began firing on the fleet, destroying the other three frigates that were escorting Bane's vessel. While attempting to flee the battle, the Star Destroyer fired on the remaining frigate's hyperdrive, damaging it to prevent them from escaping, allowing for him, his Padawan, and a team of clone troopers to board the vessel to find both Ropal and the [[Jedi holocron]], which was previously stolen from the [[Imperial Palace|Jedi Temple]] on [[Coruscant]], and bring them aboard the ''Resolute''. However, Skywalker and Tano soon discovered that Ropal had been killed by Bane and the Separatists, and proceeded to engage the bounty hunter and a force of battle droids, causing heavy damage to the vessel, which had been set to destroy itself by Bane, who had fled from the battle and lured Tano into the ship's airlock, where she was held captive. [[File:ShowdownOnBanesMunificent-CoD.png|thumb|left|270px|The Jedi and Bane standoff aboard his Munificent.]] After rescuing Tano, but not before opening the holocron for Bane, Skywalker and his apprentice chased after the bounty hunter through the frigate to retrieve the holocron. However, after realizing that the ship was doomed to explode, the two Jedi ended their chase and retreated to the hangar, where Rex and the clone troopers were waiting for them aboard a [[Sheathipede-class transport shuttle|shuttle]]. The Republic then made their escape, unsuccessful in their attempt to recover the holocron and in belief that Bane was killed aboard the frigate by the clone trooper [[Denal]]. ====Destruction of the Felucia medical station and the Battle of Saleucami==== Sometime after their victory over the Republic at Felucia in [[21 BBY]],{{TCWcanondates|217}} the Confederacy launched an [[Destruction of the Felucia medical station|attack]] on [[Felucia Medical Station HCTFF2]], a [[Haven-class medical station|''Haven''-class medical station]] located in the [[Felucia system]]. The attack, which was undertaken by two Munificents accompanying a single Separatist dreadnought, resulted in the [[Medcenter|medical station's]] destruction.{{TCW|Bounty Hunters (episode)}} [[File:FirstBattleOfSaleucami-GI.png|thumb|right|270px|The Separatist fleet engages the Republic fleet above Saleucami]] Later, during the [[Battle of Saleucami|Battle of]] [[Saleucami]], Separatist General [[Grievous]] used three ''Munificent''-class frigates in his fleet flagged by a ''Recusant''-class light destroyer. The Munificents were later engaged by a Republic fleet led by Generals Kenobi, Skywalker, and [[Adi Gallia]], who were trying to free fellow Jedi [[Eeth Koth]] from Grievous's [[Grievous's Recusant-class light destroyer|Recusant]].{{TCW|Grievous Intrigue}} ====Battles of Kamino and Sullust==== Despite the Confederacy's failure in their initial attempt earlier in the war, Grievous and the [[Dark Acolyte]] Asajj Ventress planned to launch a second [[Battle of Kamino|invasion]] on Kamino. However, before the Confederacy could launch their attack, the Republic managed to intercept a transmission between the two commanders which detailed the invasion, and resulted in the troopers of the 501st Clone Battalion and Generals Kenobi and Skywalker to reinforce the planet.{{TCW|ARC Troopers (episode)}} [[File:ReentryCapsules-ARCT.png|thumb|left|270px|Grievous's frigates endure extensive damage to deploy disguised re-entry capsules.]] Arriving in the [[Kamino system]], the Kaleesh commanded the Separatist invasion fleet, consisting of Grievous' [[Grievous's Providence-class carrier/destroyer (Kamino)|Separatist dreadnought]], flanked by three Recusants and eleven Munificents, which were secretly carrying parts under their hull to assemble ''Trident''-class assault ships to launch their attack on [[Tipoca City]]. Later, several ''Munificent''-class frigates were part of a Separatist fleet commanded by Ventress, alongside two ''Recusant''-class destroyers, and [[Unidentified Providence-class carrier/destroyer (Battle of Sullust)|one]] ''Providence''-class Dreadnought as the flagship. Ventress and her [[Asajj Ventress's fleet|fleet]] soon crossed paths with a Republic fleet commanded by Generals Kenobi and Skywalker, which resulted in a [[Battle of Sullust|battle]] to claim control over the planet [[Sullust]].{{TCW|Nightsisters (episode)}} ====Battle for the Nexus Route==== [[File:PiellCruiser-Attack.png|thumb|right|270px|Even Piell is ambushed by a Separatist fleet.]] Later in the war, after Jedi Master [[Even Piell]] had discovered the location of the [[Nexus Route]], a highly strategic [[hyperspace route]] that stretched to the hearts of both Republic and Separatist territory. The discovery subsequently led to an [[Capture of Even Piell|ambush]] on Piell and his warship by a small Separatist fleet of two Munificents flagged by a dreadnought, resulting in the Jedi's imprisonment in the [[Citadel]], a seemingly inescapable [[prison]] located on the [[Volcano|volcanic]] planet [[Lola Sayu]].{{TCW|The Citadel (episode)}} After Piell's imprisonment, the Republic [[Battle of Lola Sayu|dispatched]] a Jedi-led rescue team to extract their fellow Jedi, two [[Clone trooper officer|clone officers]], and Piell's captain, [[Wilhuff Tarkin]], from the Citadel and return them to Coruscant to prevent the Confederacy from learning of the hyperlane's coordinates. Arriving in the [[Lola Sayu system]], the rescue team, aboard a [[Shuttle 81572|stolen ''Sheathipede''-class Type B shuttle]], crossed paths with the planet's [[Lola Sayu defense fleet|defense fleet]] of four Munificents, one Lucrehulk, and one Providence.{{TCW|Counterattack}} [[File:LolaSayuDefenseFleet-CR.png|thumb|left|270px|Lola Sayu defense fleet]] Freeing the Jedi Master and his officers from the Citadel, the rescue team's shuttle was destroyed amid their escape, resulting in the Republic dispatching a [[Lola Sayu task force|task force]] of four ''Venator''-class Star Destroyers to extract their trapped comrades, which forced the four Munificents and the rest of the Separatist fleet to engage the Republic's task force.{{TCW|Citadel Rescue}} ====Capturing Adi Gallia==== At some point in the war, Grievous and his fleet of two ''Munificent''-class frigates and [[Grievous's Providence-class carrier/destroyer (Patitite Pattuna)|his]] ''Providence''-class Dreadnought launched a [[Battle of Patitite Pattuna|surprise attack]] on Jedi Master [[Adi Gallia]] and her lone Republic Star Destroyer near the planet [[Patitite Pattuna]]. The Kaleesh managed to successfully the Jedi Master after the two clashed blades with one another aboard the Star Destroyer.{{TCW|Nomad Droids}} ====Battle of Umbara==== [[File:SpaceBattleOfUmbara1-PoD.png|thumb|right|270px|The Separatist armada defends the supply ship over Umbara.]] Later in the conflict, the [[Umbaran government]] seceded from the Republic to the Separatist Alliance following the death of Senator [[Mee Deechi]],{{TCW|Senate Murders}} the representative for [[Umbara]] in the [[Galactic Senate]]. The Separatists then proceeded to establish a planetary [[Umbara blockade|blockade]] of at least six frigates and one dreadnought, which was later engaged by Republic forces during their invasion to reclaim the planet.{{TCW|Darkness on Umbara}} As the battle raged in space and on the ground, the Separatist Alliance soon dispatched a [[Unidentified Separatist supply ship|Dual Hemisphere-Omni Support Vessel]] to reinforce the native [[Umbaran Militia|Umbaran forces]] in hopes of defeating the Republic troops led by Generals Kenobi, Skywalker, and [[Pong Krell]]. To ensure the safety of the [[supply ship]], a Separatist armada of at least eight frigates, four light destroyers, and three dreadnoughts defended the vessel, but were ultimately unsuccessful as a trio of clone troopers destroyed the supply ship.{{TCW|Plan of Dissent}} ====Massacre on Dathomir==== [[File:TCW_Separatist_fleet_over_Dathomir.png|thumb|left|270px|The Separatist fleet arrives at Dathomir.]] Sometime after Ventress' failed attempt to assassinate her former master Dooku and the betrayal of his new apprentice [[Savage Opress]],{{TCW|Witches of the Mist}} the Sith Lord had discovered that Ventress had returned to the planet [[Dathomir]] in the [[Quelii sector]], the home of the [[Nightsisters]]. Upon his discovery, Dooku ordered Grievous to launch an [[Battle of Dathomir|invasion]] on the planet with the intent of exacting revenge on his former assassin and [[Mother (title)|Mother]] [[Talzin]] and wiping out the entire Nightsister clan.{{TCW|Massacre}} The general commanded an invasion fleet of four ''Munificent''-class frigates, two ''Recusant''-class destroyers, two DH-Omni Support Vessels, and his ''Providence''-class Dreadnought. Upon their arrival in the [[Dathomir system]], Grievous ordered his forces to begin landing sequence, and successfully managed to kill all of the Nightsisters, except for Ventress and Talzin. ====Attack on Obi-Wan Kenobi's fleet==== [[File:Kenobi_Fleet_Ambush.png|thumb|right|270px|Obi-Wan Kenobi's fleet is ambushed by Grievous's fleet.]] In [[20 BBY]],{{TCWcanondates|508}} Grievous and his starfleet had launched an [[Attack on Obi-Wan Kenobi's fleet|attack]] on the Republic task force of General Kenobi. The fleet consisted of two Providences, one Recusant, and was accompanied by three Munificents, one of which was destroyed amid the battle, which resulted in the destruction of Kenobi's fleet as well as his flagship ''Negotiator''.{{TCW|Bound for Rescue}} ====Invading Cato Neimoidia and Scipio==== Sometime later in the war, the Confederacy launched an [[Defense of Cato Neimoidia|invasion]] on the Trade Federation capital of [[Cato Neimoidia]]. However, the Separatist forces of six Munificents and a single Providence were met with a Republic defense force led by General Skywalker and his Padawan, [[Jedi Commander|Commander]] Tano. The Republic managed to punch through the Separatist fleet in orbit, which allowed both Jedi and a squadron of [[Clone Z-95 starfighter|clone Z-95 Headhunters]] to reach the surface, where they would engage the command ship and its accompanying frigates.{{TCW|Sabotage (episode)}} [[File:ScipioSystem.png|thumb|left|270px|Dooku's fleet invades Scipio.]] Later, during the Separatist [[Invasion of Scipio|invasion]] of the [[InterGalactic Banking Clan]] world of [[Scipio]], Count Dooku, the Confederate Head of State, commanded the invasion from his personal [[Dooku's Providence-class carrier/destroyer|''Providence''-class Dreadnought]], which was accompanied by three Munificents and two supply ships. And after the [[Serennian]] completed his mission to trick Senator [[Rush Clovis]] into raising interest rates on the Republic and not the Confederacy, the Count and his flotilla proceeded to flee the [[Scipio system|system]], and subsequently allowing the Republic to gain control of Scipio and the Banks.{{TCW|Crisis at the Heart}} ====Fight against the Shadow Collective==== =====Battle of Zanbar===== During the [[Campaign against the Shadow Collective|campaign]] against the [[Shadow Collective]], an organization created from various crime families and syndicates and led by the former Sith Lord [[Maul]], Grievous commanded a large Separatist fleet in [[Battle of Zanbar|battle]] to the moon of [[Zanbar]] after the [[Zabrak]] managed to escape from the [[Spire (Stygeon Prime)|Spire]] [[prison]] on the planet [[Stygeon Prime]]. The fleet consisted of Grievous's ''Providence''-class Dreadnought, as well as at least eighteen ''Munificent''-class frigates, two ''Recusant''-class warships, five DH-Omni Support Vessels, and at least five C-9979 landing craft.[[Darth Maul — Son of Dathomir 1|''Darth Maul — Son of Dathomir'' 1]] =====Battle on Ord Mantell===== Not long after their victory at Zanbar, Grievous and his forces tracked Maul's retreat to the planet [[Ord Mantell]], where he awaited the Kaleesh's fleet. After exiting hyperspace above the planet, Grievous ordered the fleet, which consisted of several ''Munificent''-class frigates, support ships, a single [[Lucrehulk-class LH-3210 cargo freighter|''Lucrehulk''-class LH-3210 cargo freighter]], and multiple landing craft, all flagged by the ''Providence''-class Dreadnought ''[[Invisible Hand]]'', to initiate an [[orbital bombardment]] on the [[Ord Mantell City|city]] of Ord Mantell. Despite the bombardment, Maul deployed several [[Kom'rk-class fighter/transport|''Kom'rk''-class fighter/transports]] to engage the fleet, where he managed to storm the ''Invisible Hand'' and capture Grievous.[[Darth Maul — Son of Dathomir 2|''Darth Maul — Son of Dathomir'' 2]] ===Other battles=== [[File:Munificent-class.png|thumb|right|300px|The ''Munificent''-class frigate ''Tide of Progress'' fought at the Battle of Crombach Nebula.]] The ships continued to be used throughout the entire Clone Wars.{{Film|III}} The weaknesses of the ''Munificent''-class were covered within an issue of ''[[Space Battles]]'' magazine, which was published by the [[Republic Naval Institute]] and saw circulation during the war.{{TCW|A Distant Echo}} During the [[Battle of Crombach Nebula]], [[Jedi Master]] [[Wom-Nii Gnaden]]'s [[NTB-630 naval bomber]] collided with a Munificent. This left an impact mark that was still visible on the frigate by the [[time]] of the [[Battle of Coruscant]], a battle in which multiple ''Munificent''-class star frigates were involved.[[Star Wars: Complete Locations (2016)|''Star Wars: Complete Locations'']] ===Later history=== The [[Vontorian treasure ship]] ''[[Graceful Promising]]'' shared visual similarities with a ''Munificent''-class star frigate.''[[Star Wars: Smuggler's Guide]]'' During the [[New Republic Era]], the [[pirate]] [[Gruk]] came to control a surviving [[Gruk's Munificent-class star frigate|''Munificent''-class star frigate]], using the vessel in the [[Lost Clusters]].
